description: This file defines an AuthService object for managing user authentication, including login, registration, logout, and user state subscription in a React.js web application. It interacts with a RESTful API backend and manages user data in localStorage.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the current user object from localStorage or null if not available or on error.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Allows other parts of the application to subscribe to user authentication state changes.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Allows other parts of the application to unsubscribe from user authentication state changes.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Sends login request to backend API, stores user data on success, and notifies subscribers.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user via API; does not log in automatically.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Removes user data from localStorage and notifies subscribers of logout.
